name: DISA STIG
description: Department of Defense Security Technical Implementation Guide for Network Infrastructure.

controls.title: Disallow Insecure Telnet Protocol
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, DoD policy CAT I requirement mandates disabling Telnet completely: execute 'no service telnet' and verify 'transport input ssh' only.

controls.title: Require FIPS-Compliant SSH Protocol Version 2
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enforce SSH Version 2 with compliant cipher algorithms and disable legacy SSHv1 fallback: 'ip ssh version 2'.

controls.title: Prohibit Cleartext and Reversible Passwords
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, CAT I finding: replace all unhashed passwords with modern Type 9 (Scrypt) or SHA-512 hashes.

controls.title: Purge Default and Guessable SNMP Community Strings
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, purge 'public' and 'private' SNMP communities immediately and deploy SNMPv3 authPriv.

controls.title: Forward Syslog Events to Centralized DoD SIEM
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, configure remote logging to transmit audit records to authorized DoD syslog collectors.

controls.title: Synchronize Device Clock with Authorized Stratum NTP Servers
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, configure redundant NTP synchronization targeting approved defense network time sources.

controls.title: Display Approved DoD Warning Banner
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, configure the mandatory DoD consent-to-monitoring logon banner verbatim on all login interfaces.

controls.title: Enforce 10-Minute Terminal Idle Session Timeout
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, set idle disconnect timer to 10 minutes or fewer: configure 'exec-timeout 10 0'.

controls.title: Implement Control Plane Filtering via Access Lists
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, deploy strict access-class filtering on all VTY and console lines to prevent rogue control-plane probes.

controls.title: Disable IP Source Routing
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, eliminate source-directed route packet manipulation by issuing 'no ip source-route'.
